title: Helicopter
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- rotor blade -->
  <rect x='8' y='14' width='84' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <!-- rotor hub -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='17' r='5' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <!-- rotor mast -->
  <rect x='47' y='20' width='6' height='6' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <!-- tail boom -->
  <rect x='58' y='40' width='30' height='7' rx='3' fill='#4aa3d8'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M84 40 L94 30 L94 47 L86 47 Z' fill='#2f7fb8'/>
  <!-- tail rotor -->
  <circle cx='92' cy='38' r='6' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='38' r='2' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='47' rx='24' ry='14' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='14' ry='6' fill='#ff8a8a'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='47' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#bfe9ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='44' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#e8f7ff'/>
  <!-- skid struts -->
  <rect x='30' y='60' width='3' height='9' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <rect x='50' y='60' width='3' height='9' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <!-- skids -->
  <rect x='22' y='69' width='30' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <rect x='42' y='69' width='18' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffd24d'/>
  <!-- stripe on body -->
  <rect x='20' y='54' width='26' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd24d'/>
</svg>
